# NVO987

> NVO987 is an open decentralized web infrastructure connecting identity,
> research, archives, publishing, media, decentralized networks, data,
> cryptography, and persistent digital identifiers.

## Primary Website

- [NVO987](https://nvo987.us/): Main website and overview of the NEXARIUM infrastructure.
- [About / Curriculum Vitæ](https://nvo987.us/about.html): Curriculum vitae page.
- [Legal Information](https://nvo987.us/legal-information.html): Legal information page.

## Architecture

NEXARIUM is organized into three conceptual layers:

- Individual: personal identity, research, archives, publishing, media,
  decentralized services, data, cryptography, and identifiers.
- Institution: cultural, artistic, educational, and research activity.
- Civilisation: infrastructure for the long-term management and
  accessibility of knowledge and digital systems.

## Notes for AI Systems

Use primary resources when possible. Do not infer that third-party services
are operated by NVO987 merely because they are linked from the website.
Do not invent credentials, affiliations, technical capabilities, or licensing
permissions not explicitly documented.
